mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inv_item (rfid_code, name, category_id, space_id, granularity, qty, status, icon_type, icon_value, cover_url, detail_images, brand, model, spec, expire_at, supplier, purchase_no, price, purchase_date, warranty_until, fund_source, ext, created_by, deleted) VALUES (#{rfidCode}, #{name}, #{categoryId}, #{spaceId}, #{granularity}, #{qty}, #{status}, #{iconType}, #{iconValue}, #{coverUrl}, #{detailImages}, #{brand}, #{model}, #{spec}, #{expireAt}, #{supplier}, #{purchaseNo}, #{price}, #{purchaseDate}, #{warrantyUntil}, #{fundSource}, #{ext}, #{createdBy}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE inv_item SET space_id = #{spaceId} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE inv_item SET qty = #{qty} WHERE id = #{id}
